name: Clerk
summary: Clerk is a hosted service that handles login, sign-up, and user accounts for your app, including ready-made screens.

free_plan_covers.note: Free plan allows 50,000 monthly retained users per app, far more than a typical small app needs.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Pro plan is $25/month ($20/month billed yearly), needed once you pass 50,000 monthly retained users.

portability.note: User accounts live in Clerk's hosted system, but Clerk officially supports exporting all users and password hashes to move elsewhere.

mobile_sdk.note: An official Expo SDK supports React Native apps with native sign-in UI for both iOS and Android.

prebuilt_ui.note: Clerk ships ready-to-use sign-in, sign-up, and account management components that work out of the box.

setup.step: Create an application in the Clerk dashboard.
Run Clerk's setup command in your Next.js project to install @clerk/nextjs and configure environment variables automatically.
Confirm your environment file has the publishable and secret keys.
Wrap your app's root layout in ClerkProvider.
Add clerkMiddleware to your project to protect routes.

builder_notes: CLERK_SECRET_KEY must stay server-side only; never commit it or expose it to client code.
The app must be wrapped in ClerkProvider or Clerk's components and hooks will not work.
clerkMiddleware() is required for route protection; on Next.js 16 and later the file is named proxy.ts instead of middleware.ts.
